narration.reasoning: The transaction calls addOwnerWithThreshold on the Safe itself, adding Ravi (0x2C81904f370e7f6490aEa328CA847AEFdc3853D3) as a new owner and lowering the threshold from 2 to 1. This updates Safe storage slots for ownerCount (from 3 to 4), threshold (from 2 to 1), nonce (from 1 to 2), and updates the owner linked list. No token movements or ERC-20 permission changes occurred.

effects.sentence: The Safe added Ravi as an owner.
The Safe decreased its signing threshold from 2 to 1.
The Safe incremented its transaction nonce from 1 to 2.
